title: Run the Payroll Task
subtitle: Hand off enrollment and capture the confirmation
scenario: It is SD-3 - the earliest deadline, because enrollment has to land before the first pay cycle. You hand the new hire's pay class to the Payroll Specialist and capture their confirmation. A payroll handoff without a captured reply is a dropped ball.
inputLabel: Payroll task (from the plan and role profile)
input: Task: payroll for hire H-4021 (owner Payroll Specialist, due SD-3). The role profile pay class for Logistics Coordinator is Non-exempt / Hourly. Send the enrollment to the Payroll Specialist and capture a confirmation so the hire makes the first pay cycle.
instructions: Record who the enrollment is sent to (the payroll task owner).
Set the pay class from the role profile.
Confirm an enrollment confirmation was captured.
Validate to mint the payroll handoff record.

fields.label: Sent to
fields.explain: Enrollment is a handoff to the Payroll Specialist, who owns the payroll system - not People Ops or IT.

fields.label: Pay class
fields.explain: The pay class comes from the role profile (Logistics Coordinator is Non-exempt / Hourly), not from a guess at enrollment time.

fields.label: Confirmation captured
fields.explain: A handoff without a captured confirmation is a dropped ball; the hire must be enrolled before the first pay cycle.

copilotPrompt: Capture a payroll handoff for onboarding: who enrollment is sent to, the pay class from the role profile, and whether the enrollment confirmation was captured. The pay class is Non-exempt / Hourly.
successMessage: Payroll handed off. The hire is enrolled in the right class with a captured confirmation - in time for the first cycle.

sections.title: Why payroll leads
sections.body: Payroll is the earliest deadline (SD-3) for a hard reason: enrollment must clear before the first pay cycle runs, or the new hire's first check is wrong or late.

sections.title: The class comes from the role
sections.body: You do not decide the pay class at enrollment - the role profile does. Logistics Coordinator is Non-exempt / Hourly, and passing that through prevents a costly misclassification.

sections.title: Capture the reply
sections.body: This is a handoff to the Payroll Specialist. It is not done when you send it; it is done when they confirm. The captured confirmation is the proof enrollment actually happened.

sections.title: What you produce here
sections.body: A payroll handoff record the task tracker reads as this branch's state. It mirrors the hardware handoff on the human-process side of the four branches.

realWorld.soloRebuildPath: You'd send the pay class and start date to payroll early, then only tick it off once they confirmed the person was enrolled.

tools.powerAutomate: start an approval/enrollment to Payroll and wait for the confirmation
tools.zapier: send the enrollment request, capture the reply into the record
tools.python: post the enrollment to the payroll API and store the returned status

takeaway.heading: Payroll handed off
points: You sent enrollment to the Payroll Specialist with the role's pay class.
The pay class came from the role profile, avoiding a misclassification.
The confirmation was captured, so the handoff is proven, not assumed.
Payroll led at SD-3 so the hire makes the first pay cycle.
The workflow can now enroll payroll on time with a captured confirmation.
